reviews.text: It's like visiting family who have medical degrees! The office is welcoming and stress-free. The entire staff are friendly, knowledgeable and informative. They take their time to make sure all your questions are answered and then some.

This review has been a long time coming. Our cat has been dead for over a year now, so we are no longer afraid of burning bridges.
We brought our cat to Alison for several years. At first they seemed fine, when our cat was relatively healthy,. But has he aged and began to develop more serious health problems, they proved themselves worse than useless, not only ignoring signs of major illness (brain cancer) but misdiagnosing him with other ailments based on nothing and trying to push useless or even harmful treatments on us.
When a blood test came back with slightly elevated thyroid levels, Dr. Ryan hastily diagnosed him with hyperthyroidism and recommended immediately placing him on drugs that would destroy his thyroid, making him dependent on them, as well as require constant blood monitoring, ignoring the fact that the first line treatment for hyperthyroidism is radiotherapy. Thankfully we decided on radiotherapy, but when we took him to the specialist for imaging, he discovered nothing but a perfectly healthy thyroid. Who knows how many cats lives she has ruined with similar overhasty diagnoses, with owners who were daunted by the higher upfront cost of radiotherapy (though cheaper overall) and immediately went along with her recommendation?
On other occasions, their doctors behaved not just incompetently, but unprofessionally. One doctor stuck his finger in our cat's ear, and when he flinched declared that he must have an ear infection. When we mentioned that he does not drink much water, he immediately suggested giving a subdermal hydration injection. When we asked if he saw any signs that our cat was dehydrated he became defensive, asking if I had a medical degree. Eventually dropped it when he could not provide any explanation why our cat needed this injection.
When our cat was diagnosed with arthritis, they prescribed him Solensia, which worked wonderfully, but was very expensive to administer. One of their technicians taught us how to administer the injections ourselves at a fraction of the cost, which we did for several months with no issue. When our supply ran out we asked for a refill, but suddenly they started making an issue of us doing it ourselves. For days our cat suffered, barely able to move, because they would not provide the medication. Eventually they relented and said they would let us know when we could pick up the Solensia; days passed without any word. After many phone calls, eventually they said it would be ready that day, but when they still did not call I decided to go down there myself and wait for when the order was ready.
While I waited silently in the lobby, causing no disturbance, an impatient doctor came out, who I now know to be Dr. Alexander Klein. He rudely asked what I was doing and said that I could not wait there, despite having been told that I would be able to pick up the medicine that day. I told him that I was not leaving without  the medicine that my cat needed, that they had promised, and eventually he relented, but not before insulting me and suggesting that I was lying when I told him we knew how to administer the injections ourselves.
That was the last straw. We never took out cat back to them again. Later, our cat was diagnosed with brain cancer. For over a year, he had been rubbing his head in a strange way which we had brought up to Alison again and again, but they always waved it away as an itchy ear. It turned out that he had a tumor which was so large it was breaking through the side of his skull, causing tremendous pain.
If your pet is not a patient here already, do not take them. If they are, take them somewhere else. And if any of their doctors have given your pet a major diagnosis requiring numerous expensive treatments, make absolutely sure you get a second diagnosis before giving them a single cent of your money.
We love Dr. Ryan! She and everyone else at Alison animal always take the absolute best care of Della.

The best vet in Brooklyn! We have been taking our sweet 14 year old Russian Blue to Alison Animal Hospital for ten years. All of the doctors we've seen here are equally kind, informative, and respectful. The front desk staff is just as lovely. I love supporting a locally owned and operated vet clinic and I couldn't recommend them enough!
We always have a great experience - the staff are all caring and personable.

Alison is the best - one of the few remaining non corporate practices in the area and you can tell by the care they take with your animals. we’ve always been very pleased with the care our fluffs have received at Alison (both routine and emergent) since we moved to NYC five years ago. Dr Klein and Dr Ryan are the best!
everyone is so helpful and friendly!

Our experience with Alison Animal Hospital has been beyond stellar. The team at the desk is responsive, all emails are answered promptly. The team of vets and techs have been so kind and helpful with a variety of issues with our aging cat with cerebellar hypoplasia. Big shout out to Lily, our cat is like mush in her care.

Alison Animal Hospital is the best, caring, friendly and professional.They have taken excellent care of our wonderful Shepherd. The facility is state of the art and the environment so pleasant. The staff is responsive and goes out of their way to make sure you’re taken care of.
Great bedside manner, attention, care, support, insight, experience all around

The techs at AAH are veery patient and knowledgeable. They obviously love and care about animals.

We didn’t see Dr Ryan this time because we were there for a tech visit, but she’s been caring for our cats since 2015 and we love her. She explains every situation and issue clearly, and is compassionate and accessible.

Our experiences at AAH have always been positive, and I frequently recommend them to friends and neighbors.
Thank you to Michelle at the front desk for helping me during a difficult time. You are very sweet ☺️

I am truly grateful to Alison Animal Hospital for the compassion and excellent care they have shown my beloved 16-year-old dog, Polito.

About eleven months ago, Dr. Alexander helped us through an extremely stressful moment. He treated Polito with kindness, honesty, and great professionalism. Instead of recommending a procedure that could have been risky because of Polito’s age and health, he carefully explained the safest option and put my dog’s well-being first. I will always be thankful for the peace of mind he gave me during such a difficult time.

Now, Dr. Rodrigo Suarez is helping us with Polito’s health once again, and I feel equally grateful. Dr. Suarez is compassionate, patient, and genuinely concerned about both his patients and their worried families. He listens carefully, explains everything clearly, and treats Polito with such gentleness that you can truly see his love and passion for animals.

When I shared how overwhelmed and concerned I felt after everything we had already been through with Polito’s care, Dr. Suarez responded with genuine understanding and kindness. He showed us a special level of consideration that helped us continue moving forward with the care Polito needed. That thoughtful gesture meant more to me than I can express, especially during such an emotional and stressful time.

I also sincerely appreciate Josh, Janet, and the entire staff for always being kind, attentive, and supportive.

Receiving this level of care from two different doctors has shown me that Alison Animal Hospital is filled with professionals who have not only excellent medical knowledge, but also genuine empathy and heart. When your pet is part of your family, finding people you can truly trust means everything.

I wholeheartedly recommend Alison Animal Hospital to any pet owner looking for compassionate care, honest guidance, and professionals who will genuinely do their best to find the right solution for their pet. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking such wonderful care of our Polito.
Ervita Katehis

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I honestly can’t recommend Alison Animal Hospital enough. Everyone there has been amazing with my senior dog. The doctors never make me feel rushed and always take the time to explain everything in a way I understand. The technicians are so kind and patient, and the receptionists are always friendly and helpful, even when they’re really busy. I know I’m probably one of those pet parents who asks a million questions, especially since my dog is getting older. Matthew, the office manager, has been incredible. He even gave me his personal email address so I could reach out if I had any questions, anxieties or concerns. Every single time I’ve emailed him, he gets back to me quickly and always tells me I’m never a bother. That kind of reassurance means more than he probably realizes. You can tell everyone here truly loves what they do and genuinely cares about the animals and the people who love them. It’s hard to find a veterinary hospital where you feel this supported, and I’m so grateful I found Alison Animal Hospital. My dog is in the best hands, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with his care.

Dr. Ryan is amazing, caring and very thorough. Palina and Josh were great to my baby. Michelle at the front desk was so helpful and super nice from the moment we arrived. Alison animal hospital is amazing. What a wonderful experience from the moment we arrived to the moment we left. What a great team they have.

We spent a long time searching for a veterinary clinic in Brooklyn and finally found exactly what we were looking for. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the friendly and welcoming atmosphere created by the staff. Everything inside is clean and well-organized. A special thank you to Dr. Susan and the veterinary assistant Palina they are true professionals. We have never had such a great experience before. Our cat Persik was happy too.

Dr Ryan and the vet techs are wonderful and true animal lovers. The reception crew is also great :)
Thank you for your dedication and care.

A great experience for me and my newly adopted dog! Dr. Ryan is very experienced, thorough, patient and knowledgeable! The staff were all kind and helpful, and the place was very clean! Alison has my highest recommendation!
We trust them with the welfare of our beast. That should say a lot.

Dr. Ryan is an amazing, careful, thorough, and warm practitioner. My dog loves seeing her, even when she has vaccines, or blood drawn. And the whole team is just great. We are very happy with the care we get at Alison!
Everyone was exceptionally kind, attentive, and thorough in their care and explanations.

Dr Ryan was great--loving, detailed and attention to everything, but in no way over cautious, which I find unkind to animals. (early/ often surgeries/ treatments for animals can cause more suffering instead of easing illness/ disease)  Everyone was warm, answered all my questions, showed me all the details and records, and gave me a 360-degree view of my cat's health. Awesome.

Caring team that clearly loves animals. I have brought three pets here and am consistently impressed with their patience and the way they understand animals (especially Dr Klein with my VERY anxious dog). They are responsive to email and get back to me quickly. Prices are on the higher side, but I feel like you get what you pay for with Alison...

Can't reccomend this place enough.  Amazing staff, very helpful and knowledgeable.  Our cat just passed away and they treated us with such love and kindness and just can't get over the fact at how cared for I felt as they treated us when it happened.
We love Alison Animal! Highly recommend !

LOVE. AAH is so unusual. I had a meeting with Dr Klein today—I’m hesitant to share how long it was, because I don’t want every single person to think he has that kind of time—but suffice to say, Kitty was very, very ill, and he lavished us with kind, insightful—no, brilliant—professional attention. It was amazing. He has true integrity. You unfortunately rarely run into people in this busy, monetized world like him. He is a natural caregiver. And he is, without question, fantastic.

Every member of the staff of AAH cares. They’re busy. But they never, ever brush you off, shortchange your concerns, or fail to help you. As I said, Kitty recently has been in dire need. But she has been going to AAH since she was a 2-pound kitten, and each member of the staff, at all levels, has been equally kind, attentive, loving. Special shout-out to Janet and especially Kalli at the desk!!  I feel funny naming just a few people, though, because everybody throughout these past 12 years has been the best.

—Btw, Kitty has only been to my apartment, & Alison Animal Hospital (and once, to an emergency vet), in her whole life. So when I put her in her carrier, she knows where she’s going. SHE NEVER HESITATES TO GO TO THE VET, NOT IN THE LEAST. I attribute this complete surrender some to her sweet nature of course. But this is also clearly a testament to the relentlessly kind treatment she has received at AAH.

Trust in this place. You can.  They will never push an unnecessary surgery, they’ll never, ever do what’s wrong. They truly want what’s best for your little one.  They truly care. EDITED

I once had a 5-star review for this place, but no longer. They do not care at all anymore. I brought my cat here because she was listless and losing weight. They ran tests, failed to get back to me; I called and brought her back in; they ran more tests and failed to tell me to book a follow-up appointment even though it was in her chart. The director was all apologies, swore the vet would call me back “this time”, but no. Thousands of dollars later with no real answers or meaningful treatment, my cat was still not eating so I thank goodness I took her somewhere they actually provide care.  The new vet immediately prescribed appetite stimulants and other meds, and just two days later my cat is doing better, has more energy, is eating enthusiastically and is gaining weight back.
Don’t bring your pets to Alison. The care is the most expensive I’ve ever encountered and they frankly don’t care if your pet lives or dies. When I called to transfer my cat’s records they didn’t even ask me why I was leaving the practice, and no-one has bothered to follow up.
My cat has a lot of issues and the doctors and technicians here are all so understanding and helpful. I am really happy to have them as our vet!

*Haven’t been in personally for an appointment, because they were all booked* but - they still gave me great advice for how to address my dog’s health issue, which really put me at ease. Very friendly people, will be bookmarking them for the future if ever needed

i love this office. the staff is nice & helpful. the office is bright & clean. you’d be hard pressed to find a more compassionate, patient doctor in Dr. Ryan. she has a genuine way about her that makes you feel like she cares about your pet as much as you do. very happy this is my neighborhood vet office.

I don't recommend Alison Animal Hospital for cats or for your inbox (SO much spam, forever, no matter how many times you unsubscribe. They sell your data). They do not consider that an animal is frightened at the vet, and their approach was extreme. My cat went for a routine exam. I was surprised when the very loud female vet tech immediately reached for steel mittens to handle him before he was even out of his carrier. I have never seen this before (or since). They refused to give him shots or take blood unless he was sedated. Again, never seen this before. He was quiet and terrified. But they like to talk: same female tech trying to upsell a dental clean with general anaesthetic that he did not need (the female vet admitted this to me later). We changed vets and went to Animal Kind where it is a completely different experience.

Dr Vinitsky, Palina, Jarlin and the reception staff are incredible! We have just moved from overseas and we couldn’t be happier that we found a compassionate, friendly and professional team for our grumpy and beautiful boy!
Ty :)
Everyone at Alison is knowledgeable, kind and patient - from the lovely front desk staff to the doctors. They take the time to truly help and clearly really care about pets and people.
I love everything about Alison Animal Hospital! The doctors, technicians, front desk people, everyone has been loving towards my pets. I'd recommend Alison Animal Hospital to anyone!

My elderly dog got suddenly very ill. Dr. Klein was able to see him the same day I call. After carefully taking his history and running a number of tests he was able to figure out what was wrong with him. Within 24 hours our 15 year old Shiba started to feel better. We are extremely greatly to Dr. Klein and his wonderful team!
Very organized and communicative - they explained everything very well to me at every step!

The most amazing team! Thank you so much for taking such great care of my pets. If you are looking for a team devoted to the well being of your animals, look no further! These are the most compassionate and caring staff!
Wonderful care from wonderful vets and staff for my two kitties!
Super knowledgeable and skilled Doctor. The staff is also very caring and qualified. This is honestly the best Vet I have been to!

Excellent service comes at a premium - but they take care of everything so well.  No wait times, excellent follow-up, and the best treats!  Our dog makes a beeline to their door when we are just walking by.

I came to Allison vets with an emergency for my dog's severe ear infection that had not been treated properly  for over 4 weeks, and possibly over 7 years at Animal  kind vets.

Dr vitinsky , at allison vets told me that my dog needed an emergency operation ASAP
She  arranged for my dog's emergency operation at a hospital that specializes in severe ear infections  As a result of animal kind's neglect , in addition to milking me  for repeated tests that they told me showed no infection!!! , my dog will LOSE  her hearing from this infection and neglect.
At least my dog wont lose her life because of Allison vets.competance and compassionate intervention.

I come to Alison Animal Hospital specifically for Dr. Ryan — she’s an incredible veterinarian who truly cares about her patients. You can tell she has a genuine love for animals and rescue work, which I find so important in a vet. Her techs, Liana and Josh, have helped us on multiple visits and are always kind, professional, and amazing with our pets. I’m slowly transitioning from my previous vet, but I’ll be bringing all five of my cats here for their yearly visits and any other care they need. Highly recommend Dr. Ryan and her team!
Ty:)

Every person at the office was kind and knowledgeable- the staff and vet team took such great care of our cats. They took the time to go over their history and tailored the visit to each cat’s needs.

The cats also rate Alison Animal Hospital 10/10 for treats and saying how pretty they are!
Everybody is amazing and you can tell they are true animal lovers, my kitties are treated like royalty when they visit.

Today I took my 16-year-old dog, Polito, to Alison Animal Hospital, and I honestly cannot express how grateful I am for the care we received. From the very first moment, the experience was outstanding: the hospital is welcoming, clean, and beautifully kept, which immediately gave me peace of mind. At the front desk, the staff was kind and professional, and within just a couple of minutes, we were already being helped.

The assistant, Josh, was incredibly friendly and attentive. He listened carefully, reviewed Polito’s history, and made me feel completely at ease. Shortly after, Dr. Alexander came in, and that’s when I truly understood what makes this hospital so special.

I had originally gone in for a dental cleaning because I noticed tartar on Polito’s teeth. However, Dr. Alexander, with genuine empathy and great knowledge, explained that due to my dog’s age and the neck and back pain he was still experiencing, anesthesia would be too risky. Instead of simply performing the procedure for the sake of profit as happens so often elsewhere, he put Polito’s health first. He prescribed antibiotics, kindly explained how they work (even using a small whiteboard to make it clear), and asked me to return in a couple of weeks for a follow-up evaluation.

What impressed me the most was the honesty and compassion. At no point did I feel rushed or pressured into unnecessary treatments. On the contrary, Dr. Alexander and his team took their time to ensure I fully understood the situation and that Polito received only what was truly needed. That kind of dedication and integrity is rare to find.

I left the hospital feeling relieved, cared for, and truly thankful, knowing I had found a place where pets are treated with the same love and respect as family.

I highly recommend Alison Animal Hospital 100%. If you love your pet and want them to be treated with kindness, professionalism, and genuine concern for their well-being, this is the place to go. My heartfelt thanks to Dr. Alexander, Josh, and the entire team for their outstanding service and compassion.

The clinic is very clean and modern, also easily accessible by bus and train. The staff and doctors were kind and attentive. They handled my large, nervous dog incredibly well. All procedures and follow-up care were explained to me clearly, all my questions were answered and I felt like I could trust them with my dog’s health.

Absolutely amazing vet clinic! The staff is compassionate, knowledgeable, and truly cares about the well-being of animals. They took great care of my pet, explained everything clearly, and made us feel at ease throughout the entire visit. You can tell they love what they do. Highly recommend to any pet parent!
street with declining health got a lot of sincere care from all staffs of Alison Animal Hospital and we felt we can trust the care and hope for the best. Thank you !!

Great experience with Dr. Klein. We brought our 4 year old German shepard in for dental exam. 4 of his canine c teeth had some wear and tear... fearing possible future infection, we figured let's get professional opinion... thats exactly what we got, dr. Klein quickly diagnosed our pup, and explained clearly and concisely that it was not exposed pulp in his teeth we were seeing, but rather a self healing mechanism in which his body began to produce dentin to help fill in the lost enamel. Dr. Klein explained that possible cause was him carrying around a ball, which was slowly wearing away at the enamel, so we now know to modify that behavior.  We feared the worst and got the best news possible, big thank you to dr. Klein and the entire allison animal hospital staff.

After moving to Brooklyn I was eager to find  a reliable veterinarian clinic for my two Pomeranians. I previously followed at Bond Vet, but needed a change. I read positive reviews for Alison Animal Hospital and took a chance. We have now been there for about 2 years and love Dr. Susan Ryan and Dr. Alex Klein. My dogs have undergone major surgical procedures and were given great pre-op and follow up care. The entire team is great at responding to questions and providing care recommendations. I highly recommend their clinic.

I switched my dog's vet to Alison because I recently moved to the neighborhood. To preface, the vet we saw and vet assistants were really lovely.

I am leaving this review because the bill I received for my dog's routine annual check-up was $550 higher (!!) than my previous annual visit with my last vet in Brooklyn, who was also lovely and provided an equally high quality of care. I wanted to leave a review for owners who are thinking of moving their pets here. It is very, very expensive! Perhaps ask for estimates of up-front costs if you are considering Alison.

I would not recommend Alison Animal Hospital to anyone, especially if you care deeply about your pet’s well-being. I adopted my cat in December through Sean Casey Animal Rescue and started bringing her here for her vaccinations and care. Unfortunately, my experience has been nothing short of frustrating and disappointing.

Over the course of several visits, I raised concerns about my cat’s ongoing symptoms, particularly bloody soft stool, diarrhea, and abdominal bloating. Despite paying for multiple fecal tests, every result came back inconclusive. I felt like my concerns were dismissed, and the front desk staff consistently told me that the only people allowed to examine my cat during her vaccinations were the ones administering the shots, which made it impossible for me to address her health issues with the vet.

There were also multiple instances where I had to complain about the care my cat received during her vaccinations. On TWO occasions, the vet tech had to poke my kitten twice to administer her shot, even though she is a very timid, and a non-violent cat. The shot was also administered incorrectly, and when I asked for a different person or the vet to handle the next one, I was told that wasn’t an option, despite paying for an examination fee to see the VET not a vet tech.

The last straw came after my cat’s most recent vaccination, when I noticed she had full-sized worms coming out of her after two weeks. During this time, the clinic had been giving her anti-diarrhea gel, which only worsened the situation by preventing her from passing the worms and keeping them inside her stomach. When I did my own research, I discovered that most kittens should be routinely dewormed, something Alison Animal Hospital never even suggested, despite clearly allowing my cat to suffer and knowing she was a rescue. When I reached out to the front desk via email to explain that my cat was misdiagnosed and now very sick, I received no response. It's been weeks, and they’ve yet to offer any assistance, let alone a refund or discount for the ineffective and damaging treatments.

I feel deeply betrayed by this clinic. They clearly lack the knowledge and concern for my cat’s health, and I truly feel like they were more focused on getting my money than providing the care my pet desperately needed. I am currently pursuing legal action against the clinic. As a cat parent, it’s heartbreaking to feel powerless when your pet is suffering, and I cannot trust this clinic with my cat’s care any longer.

Please, if you value your pet’s health, I would advise looking for a more professional and compassionate veterinary clinic.

Just need to give some appreciation and gratitude for the Alison Animal Hospital family. They have been with my pets for over 14 years now, including one dear pet that passed (peacefully after a long life).  Everyone at the office made such a hard day just a little easier, was warm and kind, and it made all the difference. I’m so grateful to have all my furry loved ones in their care. From the front desk to the technicians to the vets, everyone in this office provides both excellent care and is a wonderful person.
Excellent and caring staff and vets, always! Thank you for taking such great care of our pup.

Very quick and caring service from reception to the veterinarians. I also love that there is an app for tracking my kitty’s health and that the staff is proactive about sending reminders when appointments are due. 10/10 would recommend to anyone

Alison is the very best veterinarian group I've ever been to. The doctors, technicians, and reception staff are all kind, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable.  They make everything very easy whether it's a routine visit or an emergency.  I've moved a few times and had to see other vets but my dog has never been more comfortable than when she is with these folks.  Shout out to Beach who she knows so well and just trots to her exam with no hesitation when she sees him. What dog happily goes to a vet visit? Well, every dog who goes to Alison.  Worth the schlep from bay ridge for sure.
The examination was thorough, and the vets and front desk staff were terrific.
Ty!

A truly caring hospital where you and your pet feel welcomed and in good hands. The team is very professional and friendly. They do not just take your pet to the back, they give you as much as possibly the time and space to stay connected - even during  some treatments such as bloodwork. This is extremely comforting as my Dachshund is very anxious.

Dr. Ryan and Alison Animal Hospital have been caring for our cat, Clove since 2021. They provide excellent services all around. We also especially appreciate the practice's responsiveness. We recently called about an issue with Clove's eye, and a really kind vet tech returned our call right away even right before closing on a Saturday to give us advice on next steps. We highly recommend Alison!

As first time pup owners, we absolutely loved our first visit with Dr. Ryan and the rest of the Alison Animal Hospital staff! From the second we walked in, we could feel that our 8-week little guy would be in good hands. The care and attention to detail, the way that we were informed, and the time we were allowed to ask questions and address all concerns even with a late appointment were so appreciated. From the front desk, to all the techs and Dr. Ryan, we loved our first experience. We feel very at ease and would recommend to all pet owners.
Dr Ryan is such a gentle soul. Both of my cats love her. She’s very attuned on how they feel. I always recommend her to other cat parents.

I love the team at Alison - they're all so friendly and caring and patient with new pet owners. I appreciate how helpful they are over the phone and the willingness to examine photos regarding concerns before making appointments/having to come into the practice. They're wonderful!

Dr. Ryan and all of the techs and receptionists have taken care of my Hennie since 2018. As she ages and her needs grow, we’ve had to make more frequent trips - everyone always knows Hennie, is so sweet to her and incredibly caring. After appointments, Dr. Ryan makes calls to pet parents explaining everything that’s happened and even texts during emergencies. My doctor doesn’t even do that! If there’s an issue (which with senior dogs there often is!), they’re great about either getting us in for an appointment or recommending we go to the emergency vet if needed. I’m so grateful we live so close! Thank you, Alison Animal Hospital!
